title: call.claim
description: The caller said the code a page shows: bind this call to it, so the page follows the call from here. Refused with `no_code` when nobody issued that code for this agent, it expired, or another call already took it.

CallClaim.description: The code the caller said, to bind this call to the page that shows it.

code.description: The four digits, as the page shows them.
